author: GameTrailers
description: Meet Vekta and see the character in action in this new trailer for Morbid Metal, a hack-and-slash roguelite set in a dark sci-fi world. In Morbid Metal, switch characters instantly mid-fight to chain abilities into devastating combos and tear through waves of lethal machines. Take risks to gain power and build momentum as you face cinematic, challenging bosses. Death is how you evolve. Break through the simulation. Morbid Metal is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Morbid Metal - Official Vekta Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the 'At the Wake of Spring' Trailer for Arknights: Endfield, an anime action RPG developed by Hypergryph. As tensions rise across Wuling, an urgent message from Zhuang Fangyi follows after Ardashir suddenly appears in the new Marker Stone area, which serves as a critical facility central to Wuling’s stability. At the same time, Nefarith moves into an open conflict setting the stage for players’ first direct battle against her as they push deeper into the crisis threatening Wuling. Already a central figure in the storyline, Zhuang Fangyi will make her playable debut in this update, bringing powerful Electric damage and a combat style that blends lightning-based attacks with swordplay.
'At the Wake of Spring' launches on April 17, and Arknights: Endfield is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Arknights: Endfield - Official 'At the Wake of Spring' Trailer
